G. s. 39, end, a. e. <he>פ׳ טבא</he> a good workingman, v. <cite ref="D00149"><he>דָּהוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:1">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>אגריתו לי כפ׳ דאורייתא</he> you have hired me as a laborer in the Biblical sense (<cite ref="Psalms 104:23">Ps. CIV, 23</cite>; you have no right to demand additional hours); a. fr.—Pl. <he>פּוֹעֲלִין</he>, <he>פּוֹעֲלַיָּיא</he>, <cite ref="Q00303"><he>פָּעֲ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:9:4">Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>נפק לטורא לגבי פָּעֲלוֹי</he> (not <he>פעליי</he>) went to the mountain to look after his laborers; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 20:15">Yalk. ib. 20</cite>; v. <cite ref="Q01383"><he>פָּעַל</he> I</cite>.
